subject: Penetration engagement playbook and ticket flow: operational runbook v1
messages:
From: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@redteamco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@redteamco.com
Date: 2027-03-10T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: RedTeamCo draft SOW + operational runbook stub

Hi Monica —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass SOW (RT_SOW_v1.pdf) and an operational runbook stub we typically hand to customers to align on ticketing and evidence handback. High-level summary:

- Scope: authenticated web app assessment (OWASP top 10 focus), external blackbox reconnaissance, and a 2-day targeted exploit window followed by a 3-day remediation test (5 days total).
- Team: 2 senior testers + 1 lead for coordination (on-site as needed).
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical findings, reproducible PoCs, prioritized remediation list, and encrypted evidence bundle.
- Evidence: packaged as encrypted S3 object + SHA256 manifest; we can hand over via secure link or an SFTP transfer.
- Ticket flow: we can push findings into Jira (SEC-PT-424) or email into your triage queue; see runbook for options.
- Estimated cost: see cost_breakdown_v1.xlsx (hours-based estimate).

Questions for you so we can finalize the SOW:
1) Do you want us to integrate directly with your Jira project (we support webhook/email-to-ticket)?
2) Any constraints on evidence retention/chain-of-custody?
3) Are there specific IP ranges or allowlist needs for the test agents?

If this aligns, we can issue a DocuSign envelope and propose a kickoff within two weeks.

Thanks,
Emma Fisher
Engagement Lead, RedTeamCo
emma.fisher@redteamco.com

Attachment stubs: RT_SOW_v1.pdf (42 pages), operational_runbook_stub.docx (9 pages), cost_breakdown_v1.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@redteamco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RedTeamCo draft SOW + operational runbook stub

Hi Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items from our side before legal and procurement review:

- Ticket integration: yes, we prefer direct Jira issue creation into project SEC-PT-424 with a link back to your PoC artifacts. Please outline required permissions for the integration in the runbook.
- Evidence handling: we require evidence delivery as an encrypted archive to an S3 bucket we control. Retention policy: 90 days by default, with an explicit handback/secure-delete procedure. We also need an auditable manifest.
- Data protection: testers must not exfiltrate customer PII. Testing should run against staging datasets or synthetic data unless explicitly approved.
- Test agent IPs: list required. Marcus will share allowlist ranges.
- Cost: can you break down senior vs. lead hours and travel (if any)? We may prefer remote-only to avoid travel costs.

Laura and Marcus — can you confirm the compliance checklist items we need to add to the SOW (SOC2 evidence, data handling appendix)? Dev — please flag any platform-side concerns about sandbox creds and logging.

If RedTeamCo can confirm those points, I’ll move the SOW to procurement with priority.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@redteamco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@redteamco.com
Date: 2027-03-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RedTeamCo draft SOW + operational runbook stub

On Wed, Mar 10, 2027 at 10:05 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items from our side before legal and procurement review:
> 
> - Ticket integration: yes, we prefer direct Jira issue creation into project SEC-PT-424 with a link back to your PoC artifacts. Please outline required permissions for the integration in the runbook.

All good — we support two Jira integration patterns: (1) webhook that creates an issue with attachments (requires a service account + API token with Create/Attach permissions) or (2) email-to-ticket (lower privilege, attachments via hosted secure link). We recommend webhook for parity and traceability.

> - Evidence handling: we require evidence delivery as an encrypted archive to an S3 bucket we control. Retention policy: 90 days by default, with an explicit handback/secure-delete procedure. We also need an auditable manifest.

We can deliver the evidence bundle to your S3 via pre-signed URL or cross-account role; we typically provide an encrypted tar.gz + SHA256 manifest and a short chain-of-custody statement. We will include the evidence_handback_template.xlsx in the SOW and commit to the 90-day retention with documented deletion procedures.

> - Data protection: testers must not exfiltrate customer PII. Testing should run against staging datasets or synthetic data unless explicitly approved.

We agree; we'll include a clause that forbids extraction of production customer data unless a scoped, documented exception is requested and approved by your privacy team.

> - Test agent IPs: list required. Marcus will share allowlist ranges.

Attached: operational_runbook_stub.docx lists our outbound IP ranges and the agent footprints. For integration we will need a service account + API token for the webhook option.

> - Cost: can you break down senior vs. lead hours and travel (if any)? We may prefer remote-only to avoid travel costs.

See cost_breakdown_v1.xlsx — travel is optional; estimate assumes remote work. Senior tester: 40h each; lead: 12h coordination + reporting. We can replace senior with senior+mid at lower cost if you want.

Next steps:
- I’ll update the SOW with the evidence handback appendix and the Jira integration spec.
- I’ll add a DocuSign envelope link (we can set review-first if you prefer).
- Proposed kickoff windows: 2027-03-29 or 2027-04-05.

If that works, I’ll let procurement know to expect the DocuSign and send an updated SOW by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Emma

Attachment stubs: operational_runbook_stub.docx, evidence_handback_template.xlsx, cost_breakdown_v1.xlsx
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@redteamco.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RedTeamCo draft SOW + operational runbook stub

Thanks Emma — quick tech notes from platform before we finalize:

- Service account: fine to create a read-limited service account and token for the webhook. We will scope it to Create/Attach in SEC-PT-424 only and rotate the token pre-engagement.
- Sandbox creds: we require ephemeral IAM creds for any testing that touches internal APIs. We will not provide production DB credentials.
- IP allowlist: Marcus will provide the CIDR ranges; we prefer allowlist over VPN tunnels if possible.
- Logging/forwarding: please confirm you will not ship our logs out-of-band; any log data for PoC reproduction should be included only in the encrypted evidence bundle.

Also: please confirm that any exploit scripts run in the sandbox will not be automatically scheduled against customer-facing VMs. We prefer explicit approval for any active exploitation beyond vulnerability verification.

Two-week lead time after DocuSign signature works for us.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

1) Add SLAs: evidence delivery within 7 business days of report publication; retest window to be scheduled within 30 days for confirmed critical findings.
2) Add appendices: SOC2 evidence mapping and PII handling appendix (we will share a template).

Please add the updated SOW to DocuSign for a review-first workflow so Legal can suggest redlines without auto-sign. Proposed kickoff: 2027-03-29 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45 min). I’ll send a calendar invite once we have the DocuSign envelope.

Approving conceptually; proceed with the SOW updates and Dev’s technical constraints.
